name: Log meals and get AI nutrition guidance
description: Verifies a meal can be saved, appears in the daily log, and AI guidance is returned from a user prompt.
steps: Add a meal with a name and description
Request AI meal guidance using the meal description
expected: The meal appears in the meal log and a readable AI guidance response is displayed.

name: Manage pantry inventory
description: Verifies pantry items can be added, marked used or removed, and remain consistent after reload.
steps: Add a pantry item with quantity and category
expected: The pantry item is visible after refresh and disappears after removal.

name: Record and review weight entries
description: Verifies a dated weight entry is saved and shown in weight history with validation for invalid values.
steps: Enter a valid weight and date
Refresh the page and review weight history
expected: The saved weight and date remain visible after refresh, and invalid or empty values are blocked.

name: Handle empty and unavailable data states
description: Verifies the app explains empty lists and surfaces a helpful message when a save or AI request fails.
steps: Open a section with no entries
Attempt an AI request with an empty prompt
expected: Empty sections show helpful guidance and an empty AI prompt is rejected with a visible message.
